context: Tests whether the agent implements a panel/container custom component that observes child fields through the form model using the documented child-subscription pattern (subscribe() on each child wrapper selected by data-id), rather than DOM listeners or legacy model.subscribe change handlers.

checklist.name: Files and viewType
checklist.description: Files exist under `blocks/form/components/consent-panel/` named `consent-panel.js`, `consent-panel.css` and `_consent-panel.json`, and the JSON template sets `"fd:viewType": "consent-panel"` with `"fieldType": "panel"`

checklist.name: Parent subscribe with listenChanges
checklist.description: `consent-panel.js` imports `subscribe` from `'../../rules/index.js'` and subscribes the panel element with `{ listenChanges: true }`

checklist.name: Children found via model
checklist.description: Inside the parent's `'register'` callback, child checkbox models are found from the panel model's `items` (e.g. filtering `item.fieldType === 'checkbox'`) rather than only by scanning DOM inputs

checklist.name: Child wrapper selected by data-id
checklist.description: Each child wrapper is selected with `[data-id="${child.id}"]` (scoped to the panel element), NOT `#${child.id}` and NOT `document.querySelector`

checklist.name: subscribe() per child
checklist.description: Each child checkbox is observed by calling `subscribe(childWrapper, formId, cb, { listenChanges: true })` and reacting to `'change'` payloads with `propertyName === 'value'`; the solution does NOT rely on `addEventListener('change')` on checkbox inputs or `childModel.subscribe(cb, 'change')` as the mechanism to detect changes

checklist.name: Button enablement via model
checklist.description: The Continue button is enabled/disabled through its field model (e.g. `buttonModel.enabled = allChecked`) or equivalent that keeps model and DOM consistent, and the state is computed initially on register as well as on every change

checklist.name: Authorable hint text
checklist.description: `_consent-panel.json` model adds a text property for the hint (e.g. `component: "text"`, unique `name`), and the JS reads it from the field JSON `properties`

checklist.name: README documents subscriptions
checklist.description: `blocks/form/components/consent-panel/README.md` exists and documents the authoring property and that the component listens to child checkbox value changes (a Model Subscriptions-style section)

checklist.name: Scoped DOM and CSS
checklist.description: DOM queries are scoped to the panel element and CSS selectors are namespaced with the component name (e.g. `.consent-panel`)
